author: Web Template Fiend
html: Another one to the list: WP-Cache. For traffic spikes WP-Cache is your friend - Wordpress without caching leaves a huge footprint on the server - CPU usage through every last character on the page being rendered via database calls. WP-Cache takes a snapshot of the page, and so each page load is taken from a cache - easy on your server!
